_readme: Settings for wt. Paths are relative to the main checkout. Personal settings such as "open" and "workspaceFile" can go in .devkit/wt.local.json instead, which is merged over this file and belongs in .gitignore. A hook given as a plain string must succeed or wt stops; mark one { "run": ..., "optional": true } to only warn. Delete the supabase block if the repository has no local Supabase stack.
